tasks.build: deno task --filter @openelement/element build && deno task --filter @openelement/router build && deno task --filter @openelement/create build
tasks.url-pattern-list:provenance: npm ci --prefix tools/fixtures/url-pattern-list-audit --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm audit signatures --prefix tools/fixtures/url-pattern-list-audit --ignore-scripts
tasks.consumer:packaged-app: deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env --allow-net tools/consumer-packaged-native.ts && deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env --allow-net tools/consumer-packaged-lit.ts

tasks.test:e2e: deno task fixture:router-native-framework:e2e && deno task fixture:router-lit-framework:e2e
tasks.test:e2e:browsers:install: deno run -A npm:playwright@1.59.1 install chromium firefox webkit

tasks.fixture:router-request-time:e2e: cd fixtures/router-request-time && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test@1.59.1 test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium
tasks.fixture:router-request-time:e2e:browsers: cd fixtures/router-request-time && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test@1.59.1 test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
tasks.fixture:router-request-time:gate: deno task fixture:router-request-time:build && deno task fixture:router-request-time:e2e:browsers
tasks.fixture:router-native-framework:build: cd fixtures/router-native-framework && rm -rf dist && deno run --config ../../deno.json --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-env --allow-ffi --allow-sys --allow-run ../../packages/router/src/cli/build.ts
tasks.fixture:router-native-framework:e2e: cd fixtures/router-native-framework && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test@1.59.1 test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium
tasks.fixture:router-native-framework:e2e:brow: cd fixtures/router-native-framework && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test@1.59.1 test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
tasks.fixture:router-lit-framework:build: cd fixtures/router-lit-framework && rm -rf dist && deno run --config ../../deno.json --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-env --allow-ffi --allow-sys --allow-run ../../packages/router/src/cli/build.ts
tasks.fixture:router-lit-framework:e2e: cd fixtures/router-lit-framework && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test@1.59.1 test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium
tasks.fixture:router-lit-framework:e2e:browser: cd fixtures/router-lit-framework && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test@1.59.1 test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
tasks.fixture:router-lit-framework:gate: deno task fixture:router-lit-framework:build && deno task fixture:router-lit-framework:e2e:browsers
tasks.wtr:pilot: deno task wtr:pilot:compile && cd packages/element/__wtr__ && npx web-test-runner
tasks.wtr:pilot:gate: cd packages/element/__wtr__ && PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../../.. && deno task wtr:pilot && deno task wtr:pilot:negative
tasks.test:starter-smoke: deno task starter-smoke:setup && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test@1.59.1 test --config e2e/starter-smoke/playwright.config.ts
tasks.test:starter-smoke:dev: deno task starter-smoke:setup && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test@1.59.1 test --config e2e/starter-smoke/playwright.dev.config.ts
tasks.typecheck: deno task --filter @openelement/element typecheck && deno task --filter @openelement/router typecheck && deno task --filter @openelement/create typecheck
tasks.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/*.tgz dist custom-dist dist-test-* playwright-report test-results .openElement
tasks.gate:ci: deno task graph:check && deno task interface:snapshot && deno task export-files:check && deno task url-pattern-list:provenance && deno task release:state-machine:check && deno task signals:check-protocol-boundary && deno task deno-api:check && deno task validation:boundary-check && deno task build && deno task test:coverage:check && deno task fixture:router-request-time:gate && deno task fixture:router-native-framework:gate && deno task fixture:router-lit-framework:gate && deno task wtr:pilot:gate && deno task test:starter-smoke && deno task package-artifacts:check && deno task consumer:packaged && deno task consumer:packaged-app && deno task consumer:packaged-router && deno task consumer:packaged-element && deno task third-party-wc:smoke
